title: Cold Storage Inspection Log
subtitle: Cold Storage Control: records repeated checks and excursions.
description: Cold Storage Inspection Log covers storage room, zone, product lot, monitoring device, door event, alarm, and disposition. The cold-storage operations owner records Cold Storage Control check times, results, excursions, and review. Cold Storage Inspection Log keeps Cold Storage Control exceptions visible until the cold-storage operations owner handoff.
use_case: Use Cold Storage Inspection Log at cooler, freezer, cold room, loading interface, and affected product zone. Document storage room, zone, product lot, monitoring device, door event, alarm, and disposition identity before Cold Storage Control begins. Compare storage room, zone, product lot, monitoring device, door event, alarm, and disposition findings with stated Cold Storage Control criteria; route unresolved Cold Storage Control issues to qualified product-condition reviewer. For Cold Storage Inspection Log, confirm requirements for Cold Storage Control. Ask qualified product-condition reviewer to review Cold Storage Control conditions beyond the cold-storage operations owner's role.

sections.title: Monitoring review context and source record
sections.guidance: For Cold Storage Control, identify responsible parties, cooler, freezer, cold room, loading interface, and affected product zone, and the linked storage room, zone, product lot, monitoring device, door event, alarm, and disposition source.

fields.label: Product, lot, quantity, and storage requirement
Logger, sensor, probe, calibration, and alarm

sections.title: Repeated checks and recorded results
sections.guidance: Capture Cold Storage Control facts for storage room, zone, product lot, monitoring device, door event, alarm, and disposition; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Room, zone, device, or product lot
Hold, transfer, correct, escalate, or none

blocks.label: Cold Storage Control monitored controls
items: Door, seal, traffic, and loading event
Evaporator, fan, airflow, frost, and drain condition
Alarm, setpoint, sensor, and communication status
Excursion start, duration, affected scope, and containment
Qualified hold, release, rework, transfer, or disposal

sections.title: Excursions, period result, and next review
sections.guidance: Resolve open Cold Storage Control log excursions; have cold-storage operations owner record the period result, review owner, and next monitoring point.

blocks.label: Excursions, missed checks, and retained evidence
items: Product moved or released without qualified disposition
blocks.guidance: Pause Cold Storage Control when temperature history, device reliability, affected scope, containment, or qualified product disposition remains unresolved. Retain the available Cold Storage Control proof and route unresolved storage room, zone, product lot, monitoring device, door event, alarm, and disposition scope to cold-storage operations owner.
